name: Iida (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Iida city emblem in white: an outlined ring crossed by two interlaced diagonal loops.
history: Municipal flag of Iida, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 October 1957.

features.role: Iida city emblem — an outlined ring crossed by two interlaced diagonal loops
